notes: Tax year 2026: 0% on the first $10,000 of taxable income and 4% on the excess (2025 H.B. 1; DOR general information). Scheduled further cuts: 3.75% (2027), 3.5% (2028), 3.25% (2029), 3% (2030).

Exemptions: $6,000 single, $12,000 married, $8,000 head of family (head of family also gets $1,500 for the required dependent, total $9,500; dependents not modeled). Standard deduction: $2,300 single/MFS, $4,600 joint, $3,400 head of family.

Mississippi computes its own gross income and adjustments (Form 80-105) rather than starting from federal AGI; it allows 50% of federal SE tax, self-employed health insurance, and SEP/SIMPLE/qualified plan contributions as adjustments.
Not modeled: Mississippi-specific exclusions (retirement income, National Guard pay, MACS/MPACT, catastrophe savings), and credits.

Married couples filing a combined return may compute tax separately for each spouse, so each spouse with income gets their own $10,000 0% band (DOR general information). The calculator applies a single $10,000 band to joint returns, which is exact when only one spouse has income but overstates tax by up to $400 when both spouses have $10,000+ of taxable income.

seDeduction.note: Form 80-100 instructions (adjustment line 61): deduct 50% of federal self-employment taxes imposed.

seHealthInsurance.note: Form 80-100 instructions (line 58): enter the self-employed health insurance deduction claimed on the federal return.

retirementContributions.note: Form 80-100 instructions (line 51): SEP, SIMPLE and qualified plan contributions deductible to the extent deductible federally.

qbi.note: Mississippi uses its own income definition and has no QBI deduction.

localIncomeTax.note: Mississippi counties and cities do not levy a local income tax.

estimatedTax.threshold: Annual Mississippi tax liability exceeds $200 and less than 80% of it is prepaid through withholding
estimatedTax.safeHarbor: Have at least 80% of the annual Mississippi liability paid through withholding/estimates; underestimate interest is 1/2% per month (Form 80-320). Farmers/fishermen (2/3 of gross income) have special rules.
estimatedTax.form: Form 80-106 Declaration of Estimated Tax (or online via TAP)

businessCosts.annualReportFee: $0 annual report (Form F0108), filed every year
businessCosts.franchiseOrMinimumTax: None for a single-member LLC taxed as a disregarded entity or sole proprietor. (Corporate franchise tax for 2026 is $0.50 per $1,000 of capital over $100,000, minimum $25, applies to entities taxed as corporations, and is repealed from Jan 1, 2028.)
